description: Sign in to a trustlists account so this MCP can run SOC 2 analyses and trust-center access requests. Uses a device code: show the user the returned URL and code, then call again with the returned deviceCode if the result is still pending. Free directory tools never need this.

deviceCode.description: Continue a pending login from a previous result.

force.description: Start a new login even if already signed in.

waitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for approval before returning pending (default 90, max 240).

name: trustlists_login
